$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0125-layout-images.xml (Rule 10, D-030). TopImage and BottomImage on BOTH levels of a two-layout tree. They are carry-only URIs: never fetched, never rendered, and never resolved against a base - the child's are relative (../assets/) and percent-encoded (die%20top.png), and both properties must survive byte-for-byte, because a consumer that decoded the escape or resolved the path would hand back a URI its producer never wrote.
